infoModal.title: Application Info
infoModal.changePresentSimpleToDo: CONTENT: Added comprehensive guide for 'Present Simple (to do)' with the Anchor metaphor and common mistakes analysis.
infoModal.uiTweaks: UI: Added status badges ('NEW', 'BETA') to configuration options for better visibility.
infoModal.changeGrammarSingleSelect: UX: Simplified Grammar Selection! You can now select exactly one grammar topic at a time to keep the AI focus sharp.
infoModal.changeLevelSplit: UX: Major Update! Separated 'Grammar Level' (what you practice) from 'Student Level' (your general proficiency). You can now practice A1 topics with B2-level vocabulary!
infoModal.featureMistakeHighlighting: UX: Added intelligent mistake highlighting! Translation and gap-fill exercises now highlight specific typos and missing words in red.
infoModal.featureSmartValidation: UX: Smarter validation! If the AI marks your answer as correct (even if it's a synonym), your input stays green.
infoModal.changeBetterHighlighting: UX: Improved mistake highlighting! High-scoring answers (90-99%) with minor typos now show red highlights instead of just green text.
infoModal.changeRemoveTip: UX: Removed redundant practice tip section from grammar guides.
infoModal.changeCleanHighlighting: UX: Cleaner mistake highlighting for Translation tasks (Level 3). Mistakes are now bold red words instead of strikeouts.
infoModal.changeScoringRefinement: AI: Major update to 'Tutor' mode scoring! It now starts at 100% and applies specific deductions for spelling, capitalization, and grammar rules.
infoModal.changeScoringTweak: AI: Refined tutor scoring deductions for mechanics, spelling, and grammar compliance.
infoModal.changeA1Demonstratives: CONTENT: Added new A1 Grammar Guide: "This, That, These, Those".
infoModal.fixDarkModeArticles: UI: Improved Dark Mode readability for all Grammar Library articles.
infoModal.changeTeacherMode: NEW: Teacher Mode! You can now choose a persona (Supporter, Tutor, Examiner) to adjust how strict the AI is with grading.
infoModal.changeB2C1Refactor: CONTENT: Major update to B2 (Upper-Int) and C1 (Advanced) Grammar! Added new topics like Inversion, Narrative Tenses, and Mixed Conditionals with specific AI generation rules.
infoModal.changeA1Refactor: CONTENT: Major update to A1 Grammar topics! Renamed for clarity and organized into logical groups (Nouns, Prepositions, etc.).
infoModal.changeGrammarUI: UI: Improved Grammar Selector! Topics are now better grouped, and hovering shows a neat modern tooltip with the full description.
infoModal.fixLibraryReset: FIX: Loading a list from 'My Cabinet' no longer resets your CEFR level and grammar topics.
infoModal.changeGeminiTTS: AUDIO: Upgraded to Gemini AI Text-to-Speech for natural, high-quality audio.
infoModal.changeAudioSettings: NEW: Settings menu! Toggle between AI Audio (High Quality) and Browser Audio (Offline).
infoModal.changeThemePersistence: UX: Theme preference (Light/Dark) is now saved and applies instantly.
infoModal.changeLanguagePersistence: UX: Language preference (English/Ukrainian) is now saved.
infoModal.changeRouter: ARCH: Upgraded to React Router for better navigation and reliability.
infoModal.changeParser: NEW: Smart Parser! Paste raw text, notes, or messy lists, and AI will extract and translate vocabulary for you.
infoModal.changeTopicFocus: NEW: Context / Topic Selector! You can now specify a topic (e.g., "IT", "Travel") to guide the AI generation.
infoModal.changeUserCabinet: NEW: Added 'My Cabinet'! You can now save your vocabulary lists to a local library and track your activity history.
infoModal.changeOptimization: OPTIMIZATION: Major code refactoring for better performance, stability, and audio management.
infoModal.changeGrammarFocus: NEW: Added a "Grammar Focus" panel! Users can now select specific grammar topics (up to 5) to be tested in the sentence and text translation activities.
infoModal.changeFlashcards: NEW: Added Flashcards! A "Level 0" activity to quickly review terms and listen to pronunciation.
infoModal.changeTTS: NEW: Added Text-to-Speech! Click the speaker icon next to words and sentences to hear them read aloud.
infoModal.changeHelpGuide: NEW: Added an interactive 'How it Works' guide to explain the workflow.
infoModal.changeScoringDocs: NEW: Added detailed documentation for the Scoring System inside the Help menu.
infoModal.changeTooltips: UX: Added contextual tooltips for settings (CEFR, Parser, etc.).
infoModal.changeSampleData: UX: Added a 'Load Sample' button to instantly populate input for testing.
infoModal.changeFlashcardsAnim: UX: Smoother animations for Flashcards swiping and flipping.
infoModal.changeLayout: UX: Improved centering and layout consistency across all screens.
infoModal.changeHistoryBadges: NEW: Detailed history! Your 'My Cabinet' activity history now displays which Grammar Topics were selected.
infoModal.fixMobileModal: FIX: Resolved visual issue with Grammar Selector on mobile devices.
infoModal.changeMobileSwipe: MOBILE: Added swipe gestures to Flashcards for easier navigation on touch devices.
infoModal.changeMobileMatching: MOBILE: Optimized Matching Game layout for small screens (tap-to-match, better spacing).
infoModal.changeMobileLayout: MOBILE: Improved layout for history and results on smaller screens (stacked views).
infoModal.changeGrammarLibrary: NEW: Grammar Library! Browse topics and start focused practice sessions instantly.
infoModal.changeScoringLogic: AI: Updated scoring logic for B1/B2/C1/C2 levels to enforce stricter grammar focus.
infoModal.changeCheatsheet: UX: Added a downloadable infographic cheatsheet for the 'Past Simple vs Present Perfect' grammar topic.
infoModal.changeRebranding: UI: Complete redesign! VocabCrafter now features a clean, professional 'Light Mode' aesthetic.
infoModal.changeFirstConditional: CONTENT: Added comprehensive guide for 'First Conditional' (A2) with common mistakes explanation.
infoModal.changeDarkMode: NEW: Dark Mode! Toggle between light and dark themes with the button in the corner.
infoModal.changeLogo: UI: Updated logo to match the new brand identity.

helpModal.title: How to use VocabCrafter
helpModal.subtitle: Turn your vocabulary lists into interactive learning tools in 3 steps.
helpModal.step1Desc: Paste your words manually or use the Smart Parser to extract vocabulary from an article or messy notes.
helpModal.step2Desc: Choose your difficulty level and specific grammar topics you want to practice.
helpModal.step3Desc: Click 'Create' and select an activity: Quizzes, Flashcards, Translation, or Speaking prompts.
helpModal.proTip: You can save your lists to the 'My Library' to use them later without re-typing!
helpModal.scoringQuizzesDesc: Multiple Choice and Gap-Fill quizzes use a binary system. You must choose the correct answer to get a point.
helpModal.scoringTranslationDesc: The AI acts as an Expert Tutor. You start with 100%, and points are deducted or added based on your performance.
helpModal.scoringTransDeductGrammar: Grammar: -25% if you violate specific topic rules.
helpModal.scoringTransDeductSpelling: Spelling: -5% per typo or missing letter.
helpModal.scoringTransDeductStyle: Mechanics: -5% for capitalization errors (start of sentence, 'I').
helpModal.scoringTransBonus: Bonuses: +5% for perfect punctuation or advanced vocabulary.
helpModal.scoringMatchingDesc: This activity is not graded by points, but by accuracy. Try to match all pairs with zero errors!
helpModal.cefrIntro: Our AI evaluates your translations based on the expectations for each CEFR level.
helpModal.cefrA1Goal: Convey the main idea using keywords. Meaning is everything.
helpModal.cefrA1Forgiven: Spelling, capitalization, punctuation, articles, complex grammar.
helpModal.cefrA2Goal: Correct basic sentence structure (S-V-O) and basic tenses (Present/Past).
helpModal.cefrA2Forgiven: Minor spelling errors, punctuation, advanced grammar mistakes.
helpModal.cefrB1Goal: Describe experiences and maintain conversation on familiar topics.
helpModal.cefrB1Forgiven: Pauses, limited vocabulary, non-blocking grammar errors.
helpModal.cefrB2Goal: Spontaneous interaction with natives. Clear, detailed text on many subjects.
helpModal.cefrB2Forgiven: Occasional errors in complex structures that don't impede flow.
helpModal.cefrC1Goal: Stylistic sophistication, idiomatic language, and perfect grammar.
